basics.name: Karine Duarte Justino
basics.label: Data Scientist & AI Alignment Specialist
basics.summary: Data Scientist and AI Alignment Specialist leveraging a foundation in Neuropsychology to engineer mathematically precise and human-aligned AI systems. Expertise spans the entire generative AI value chain: from building distributed PySpark pipelines for 15TB+ multimodal datasets, to fine-tuning Transformer models (99.2% accuracy), to executing adversarial red-teaming and RLHF for frontier LLMs. Proven ability to translate complex clinical and business requirements into secure, scalable ML production workflows.
